official_name.value: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (Virginia Tech)

min_standing_note.value: Must be nominated by home partner university in good academic standing with limited or no failing grades or withdrawals; undergraduate exchange primarily (Master's students accepted in special circumstances).

excluded_majors.notes: 'Exchange students may take courses from all majors except Mechanical Engineering'.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: UG minimums (`24-25 Fact Sheet#page=2`): IELTS 6.5 (no subscore <6.5), TOEFL iBT 80 (no subscore <16; CBT 233), Cambridge C1, or Duolingo 115. GR minimums: IELTS 6.5 (no subscore <6.5) or TOEFL iBT 90 (no subscore <20). For exchange only, 2026-27 Fact Sheet (#page=3) also accepts DAAD B2 in each category; native speakers and English-medium university students are exempt. RHET 1020 waiver not stated.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/24-25 Virginia Tech (VT) fact sheet.pdf#page=2
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: DAAD B2 and English-medium exemption confirmed in data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=3 and on https://www.globaleducation.vt.edu/students/visiting-exchange.html.

host_language_requirement.value: English proficiency required unless native speaker or enrolled at an English-medium university.
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=3

fall_term_dates.value: 2026-08-17 to 2026-12-16 (AY 2026-2027 Fall semester incl. required orientation and final exams; arrive by Aug 16, 2026)
fall_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=2

spring_term_dates.value: 2027-01-11 to 2027-05-12 (AY 2026-2027 Spring semester incl. required orientation and final exams; arrive by Jan 10, 2027)
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=2

tuition_model.notes: Incoming bilateral exchange students pay regular tuition to their home university (host tuition waived/adjusted), while covering VT Program Fee ($75), housing/food, health insurance, and Pamplin business fee if applicable.

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=4
est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived by dividing VT 2026-2027 1-semester DS-2019 proof-of-funding living cost ($10,500 USD/sem; $21,000/AY) by 5 months = $2,100/month. Factsheet itemizes on-campus housing & food ~$7,000/sem (off-campus shared rent $500–$1,200/mo) and mandatory Aetna health insurance ~$2,000/sem.

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=4
living_cost_usd_est.notes: Official 2026-2027 1-semester exchange DS-2019 living budget / proof of funding ($10,500.00 USD per semester; $21,000 USD full year), already in USD (recorded 2026-11-15).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory J-1 health insurance: VT Aetna plan (~$2,000/semester) or VT-approved comparable policy; VT Program Fee $75; visa/SEVIS ~$400. Note: Pamplin College of Business supplemental fee applies if taking 2+ business courses (~$1,275–$2,500/sem across 2026-27 factsheet variants). Required immunizations post-acceptance.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=4
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Pamplin fee noted as ~$2,500 (2+ courses) on #page=2 and $1,275 on #page=4 ($1,275 for 7+ credits in alternate 2026-27 PDF copy); immunizations in 24-25 PDF #page=2.

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=4
housing_availability.notes: On-campus housing is NOT guaranteed for exchange students (may request during application; on-campus residents must purchase a meal plan; overflow lounge housing used in high-demand terms per Useful Info.docx). Off-campus shared rent ~$500–$1,200/mo.

housing_notes.value: On-campus housing & standard meal plan ~$7,000/semester (not guaranteed); off-campus shared housing in Blacksburg $500–$1,200/month (VT does not arrange off-campus leases).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=4

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 visa (Form DS-2019) required unless US citizen/LPR; passport must be valid >=6 months past program end (`#page=3`). Must document $10,500 USD per semester or $21,000 USD per academic year in personal or family/private sponsor liquid funds (`#page=4`).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=4

credit_system_and_load.value: US credit hours: full-time UG minimum 12 credits/semester (with >=9 credits in-person; majority of courses within/pertaining to VT major for visa compliance). Letter grading 4.0 scale (A=90–100, C=70–79).
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=2

course_restrictions_note.value: Mechanical Engineering excluded; taking 2+ courses (or 7+ credits) in Pamplin College of Business incurs a supplemental program fee (~$1,275–$2,500/sem); majority of courses must relate to student's declared VT major.
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=2

value: VT Exchange Application (access emailed after partner nomination)
All post-secondary transcripts translated into English
Passport info page scan (valid >=6 months past program end)
Proof of English proficiency (unless native speaker or English-medium university)
Financial proof for DS-2019 ($10,500/sem) & US green card copy if applicable
required_application_docs.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=3

city_tier.notes: Blacksburg, Virginia described on VT pages as a classic college town.

international_support_services.value: Global Education Office (GEO) pre-departure/J-1 advising, required week-long orientation, free airport pickup from Roanoke-Blacksburg Airport (ROA), Academic Advising, Writing Center, and Schiffert Health Center.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=1
international_support_services.notes: Free ROA airport pickup confirmed in 24-25 VT Fact Sheet #page=4; Academic Advising & Writing Center on #page=2.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall Semester & Academic Year: nomination March 1, application April 1. Spring Semester: nomination September 1, application October 1.
nomination_deadlines.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Virginia Tech/2026-2027/Virginia Tech Inbound Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=1
